name: Jausenstaion Oberkartnall
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Jausenstation Oberkartnall in Tirol!** Discover a cozy mountain retreat nestled in the heart of the **Tiroler Alps**, where hearty **Tiroler** hospitality meets rustic charm. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the stunning landscapes, indulge in a warm, traditional **Jause**—our signature platter of crispy **Kaiserschmarrn**, savory **Käsekrainer**, and fresh mountain bread. Sip on a steaming cup of **Tiroler** coffee or a frothy **Apfelstrudel** dessert while soaking in the breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks. Whether you're a local or a traveler, our **Jausenstation** is the perfect spot to recharge and savor the flavors of **Tirol**. **Come by and experience the warmth of the mountains—we’re always open for a hearty break!** --- **

Our Highlights

** - **Homemade Kaiserschmarrn** – Fluffy, caramelized, and served with powdered sugar and fresh fruit. - **Käsekrainer** – Juicy grilled sausages with melted **Tiroler** cheese, a local favorite. - **Fresh Mountain Bread** – Baked daily with local ingredients. - **Tiroler Coffee & Tea** – Strong, aromatic, and served with a smile. - **Apfelstrudel** – Warm, spiced apple strudel with vanilla sauce. --- **

Location

** Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Oberkartnall** is your gateway to adventure. Whether you're heading to the **Nordkette** for hiking or the slopes of **Axamer Lizum**, we’re your ideal pit stop. **

Visit Us

** **Jausenstation Oberkartnall** *Alpenstraße 123, 6082 Oberkartnall, Tirol* **Open daily from 8 AM – 8 PM** *(Seasonal hours may vary—check ahead!)* --- **

Pro Tip:

** Pair your **Jause** with a local **Tiroler Bier** or a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner** for the full alpine experience! --- **

Willkommen in Tirol—genieße die Pause!

**
